Typical fortnight core rules for gate queues
Staff will learn what applies on every shift
Companion Animal Travel Desk Operational Rules

This section sets the handling rules for animal travel bookings, document checks, and acceptance at the desk so staff can protect passenger safety and maintain a steady flow of service.

Staff must greet each traveler promptly, speak in clear and respectful terms, and record every service change in the desk ledger before the case is closed. The desk must verify the carrier condition, the animal's visible health, and the passenger's travel papers before any acceptance decision is made. If an animal shows distress, the carrier appears unsafe, or the traveler cannot produce the required papers, staff must pause the process and refer the matter to the senior coordinator without delay.

For rabbit travel, <<FACT F064>> Staff must place the animal in the approved carrier before screening and must not allow loose handling in the public area. The crate must remain secure, clean, and fit for transport, and staff must refuse any item that would compromise airflow, stability, or humane containment. If Maggie or any other pet arrives with damage to the carrier, the traveler must correct the problem before acceptance can proceed.

For large dog travel, <<FACT F057>> Staff must also confirm that the booking reflects the correct kennel arrangement and that the traveler understands the handling limits at the counter and gate. When a dog is accepted, the desk must attach the service note to the file and mark any special care instructions in plain language. Staff must not improvise exceptions, waive checks, or promise carriage when safety review is incomplete.

All interactions must remain calm, factual, and brief. Staff must never create a service record from memory alone, and they must report uncertain cases at once so the airline can apply the correct rule. The Companion Animal Travel Desk must keep the public area orderly, protect animal welfare, and ensure that every decision is supported by a clean ledger entry. Contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor for any doubtful case or escalation.
